scope: Universalis public factual calendar and citation reconciliation. Birmingham contains diocesan propers; name differences are not automatically national calendar errors. Reading headings retain their order and may describe multiple options; no automatic import or current-edition verification follows. Scripture text is excluded. Source Advent dates determine the liturgical-year grouping; cycle labels come from Cathfetch and are independently compared only where a public Mass page supplies them.
